title: schematic write + readback
observations: The typed write surface exists in the static API catalog (create/modify/delete/netflag/netport, wire create, save) with documented async conventions.
No write was executed: design-content write probes were not authorized for this session, so no receipt can support a covered/partial status.

Known 4.1.78 frictions from the repository's own adapter notes (eda-execution.md) still apply: new primitives commit asynchronously, property edits can be dropped, and ok:true does not mean the business operation succeeded.
risks: hand-written JS per operation, no typed contract, no idempotency guarantees
async commit timing requires waits + readback; a naive model call will report false success
no write probe means persistence is unproven
